films.title: The Forbidden Door
films.overview: A successful sculptor's life is turned upside down when he starts to receive mysterious messages from someone asking for his help. As he digs deeper, he discovers a boy is being abused and has to choose between saving the boy or losing everything.

films.title: Ritual
films.overview: A father on vacation wakes up separated from his family and races through the woods to find them.

films.title: Satan's Slaves 2: Communion
films.overview: After moving from their home to an apartment building, a new terror awaits Rini’s family.

films.title: Satan's Slaves
films.overview: After dying from a strange illness that she suffered for three years, a mother returns home to pick up her children.

films.title: Grave Torture
films.overview: When a violent act kills her parents, Sita vows to debunk the idea of supernatural torment after death — a fixation that leads her on a dark quest.

films.title: Gundala
films.overview: Sancaka has lived on the streets since his parents left him. Living a hard life, Sancaka survives by thinking about his own safety. When the condition of the city gets worse and injustice rages throughout the country, Sancaka must decide whether he continues to live to look after himself or rise to become their oppressed hero.

films.title: Impetigore
films.overview: A woman inherits a house in her ancestral village, but she's unaware that members of the community have been trying to locate and kill her to remove the curse that has plagued them for years.

films.title: Ghost in the Cell
films.overview: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.
